actors.description: Adult male standing centre-court on a blue badminton floor, facing the camera; black short-sleeve t-shirt printed with a red circular logo and the word 'ACTIVE', bright pink shorts, a small lapel microphone clipped at the collar; holds a badminton racket (orange grip) in his right hand (screen-left) and gestures with his open left hand (screen-right); smiling throughout.

storyline: A single static medium shot of one coach-like figure standing on an indoor badminton court, framed against a dark hall with a blue 'YONEX' banner overhead and a '李宇轩教练 bilibili' watermark at top right. At 7.633 s he stands upright, racket lowered at his right side (screen-left), left hand raised in an open explanatory gesture, mouth open as if speaking. Between 7.733 s and 7.833 s the racket is lifted from the lowered position to a vertical hold beside his head; the 7.733 s frame shows the racket head motion-blurred during the raise, and by 7.833–7.933 s the racket is held steady, head pointing up near the top of the frame, while his left hand continues to gesture and he keeps smiling/talking. This racket raise is a conversational illustrative gesture, not a stroke: no shuttle is visible at any point, there is no striking preparation toward an incoming bird, and no contact or outgoing path occurs. At 7.967 s (final sampled frame) a Chinese subtitle line appears at the bottom while the pose is unchanged. The shot ends with him still holding the racket upright and gesturing; the action is ongoing/cropped at the boundary. Feet remain essentially planted in a standing stance with no discernible footwork pattern.
